title: Finite-stage pro-etale internal Hom preserves the finite-Tor constructible category without separatedness
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum $p,a,q,k_0,k$ of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], so $q=p^a$ and $k$ is the fixed algebraic closure of $k_0=\mathbf F_q$. Let $\ell\ne p$ be a prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be a finite extension with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and let $n\geq1$. Put $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $T$ be a finite-type $k$-scheme [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], without a separatedness assumption. On the small pro-etale site $T_{\mathrm{proet}}$ with constant coefficient ring sheaf $A_T$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], let $D^b_{ctf}(T,A)$ be the full subcategory of the derived category of $A_T$-module sheaves consisting of complexes with bounded constructible cohomology [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility] and finite Tor amplitude [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]: for each such complex $K$ there are integers $u\leq v$ such that $K\otimes_A^L F$ has zero cohomology outside $[u,v]$ for every $A_T$-module sheaf $F$ placed in degree zero.

For every $K,L\in D^b_{ctf}(T,A)$, the ambient derived internal Hom $R\mathcal Hom_A(K,L)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] belongs to $D^b_{ctf}(T,A)$.

source.place: General etale finite-Tor preservation assertion, transferred to the pro-etale site by thm-sf-hom-comparison-constructible in the same directory; the extracted domain argument is step 1 of the returned lem-trf-exceptional-internal-hom-exchange split. No site-perfect or separatedness hypothesis is used.
